classification: New independent-source prospective study; never replaces frozen competition targets
input_cutoff: Previous UTC calendar day; observation and retrieval timestamps retained

target_definition.statistic: daily median across quality-ok AWS/Azure/GCP spot observations; SKU rate divided by GPU count
target_definition.source: Alex Hubbard independently retrieved CC BY4 archive
target_definition.gap_rule: No interpolation, forward fill or cross-series stitching
target_definition.revision_rule: First captured vintage preserved; later captures append revisions

candidate_pool: Same 42 registered identifiers shared by every v4 selector; custom numerical implementations reused unchanged. Independent-source reference adapters are defined in prospective_panel_v4.py and versioned separately from official starter baselines. Explicit auxiliary-data fallbacks are retained.
selector_scale: Frozen v2 training-only scale loaded from hash-verified derived archive; never estimated from prospective outcomes

scoring.pinball: Mean of q10/q50/q90 loss, then mean over exact matched cells
scoring.failures: Retain every failure; no implicit zero, no substitution for a failed policy; pairwise cohorts and missingness explicit
scoring.analysis_schedule: After each registered origin fully matures, descriptive cumulative results; final analysis after eight origins; no checkpoint/configuration reselection
scoring.independence: Weekly origins avoid overlapping target dates but share history and market regimes; cells are not independent
scoring.stopping: Eight origins or terminal source unavailability documented; no performance-based stopping
scoring.truth_vintage: First complete retained licensed-source snapshot collected after the final target day. Retain its hash; never select a truth revision based on scores.
scoring.cohorts: Primary A10040 and T4 transfer are reported separately; no pooled score across the cohorts.

protected_dates.rule: Never download these price partitions or use observations on these dates

publication: Only independently licensed derived observations, forecasts, scores and provenance; raw source objects retained privately
existing_commitments: Unchanged; baseline and Chronos November16/18/22 remain locked in prospective_control_v3.py

reference_adapters.last_value_empirical: Latest input plus unweighted linear empirical quantiles of matured same-lead differences over 180 calendar days; minimum8 pairs
reference_adapters.drift: Mean observed one-day change over180 days times effective lead, with centered same-lead residual quantiles
reference_adapters.seasonal_naive: Last observed weekday cycle using7-day season, with centered same-lead residual quantiles
reference_adapters.failures: Invalid positive ordered native reference quantiles fail the reference; custom method fallback uses the registered empirical reference and is recorded
reference_adapters.comparison_scope: New independent-source study; these adapters are not claimed to reproduce the original official export

exploratory_selectors.information: Same numerical feedback plus separately retained current market context available before issuance, maximum age7days
exploratory_selectors.budget: Same six numerical reveals; extra retrieval/inference usage reported separately
exploratory_selectors.comparison: Exploratory extra-information treatment; excluded from the primary equal-information selector contrast
exploratory_selectors.failure: Missing context or unavailable sampler is an explicit failure; never silently replaced by the baseline
